Name: Penny Sprite Alternate Hairstyle
Author: kuujho
Description:
This mod gives Penny's sprite a hairstyle and color more attuned to the portrait picture provided by the mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1839]stardewvalley anime mods[/url], by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/50885611]ohodavi[/url]. 


To install: 

Extract the .rar contents into the StardewValley/Content/Characters folder.

Downloads.Description: Changes Penny's sprite to more-so match her portrait look from ohodavi's  stardewvalley anime mods
